relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: After securing a master's degree from the Presidency College, Calcutta

relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: he joined as a member of faculty of Hooghly Mohsin College, in Chinsurah, West Bengal

relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: and later, as a professor of history at Behrampur College before joining the government service

relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: Thereafter, he worked at the Indian Archive where he had the opportunity to work under renowned educationist and former Union Minister of Education, Triguna Sen.

relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: In 1958, when the Sikkim Research Institute of Tibetology, present day Namgyal Institute of Tibetology (NIT), was established, Sinha was appointed as its founder director. He worked there till his retirement in 1987

relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: after which he moved to Siliguri and took up the post as the Centenary Professor of International Relations at the University of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Nirmal Chandra Sinha
relations.evidence: He also published a book, Indian war economy, in 1962, co-written with P. N. Khera.
